What you're describing is a serious breach of professional ethics and confidentiality. A therapist should not share your assessment results with your husband, especially in the context of domestic abuse, where that information could be used against you. This was wrong, and your feelings about it are completely valid.

Your safety is the priority right now. If you feel at risk, please contact a domestic violence hotline — the National Domestic Violence Hotline is available at 1-800-799-7233 or by texting "START" to 88788. You may also want to consider filing a complaint with your state's licensing board, as confidentiality violations are taken seriously. Finding a new therapist who understands both trauma and abuse dynamics could also help you process this experience in a safe, confidential space. You deserve care that protects you.
